subject: E4.1 step 4: full verification (quadruple + full suite + CPAN board), then STOP
description:
DONE s357 — measured, written up in docs/e41-step4-verification-s357.md; data in docs/perl-suite-run-s357.tsv + docs/cpan-board14-s357.tsv.

QUADRUPLE GREEN: corpus emission identical across 111 files; gate 131/4658 PASS; sweep GATE clean (0 new / 0 fixed, TOTAL passing 18499 = baseline); census 111/111.

THE TWO WIDER POPULATIONS ARE NOT: the flip took coverage dark in code that was never audited for live v1 routes.
 - perl suite: 28 files newly TRANSPILE-FAIL = ~15,129 previously-passing rows. Attribution MEASURED, not inferred: a worktree at 26ce393 (pre-flip) prints `pipeline=v1` for all 28. (op/for.t is a 29th TRANSPILE-FAIL but was ALREADY dead pre-flip — PPI parse failure — so it is NOT a flip loss.)
 - CPAN board: 1794 -> 1028 ok. All of it is Text-Balanced: lib/Text/Balanced.pm hard-errors `Parser2 TODO: forward goto to a standalone label` and every t-file uses it, so 9 files -> FAIL 0/0 = 766 rows. Pre-flip that module was pipeline=v1.

WHY MISSED: the s352 §1 amendment named exactly three audit populations (sweep + CPAN board + Pl/t gate); the perl suite is a FOURTH and was not in the list. And the board WAS audited yet still missed Text::Balanced — mechanism: PCL_V2_AUDIT_LOG records at TRANSPILE time, and a module resident in ~/.pcl-cache is never re-transpiled, so a warm cache reports zero for exactly the already-compiled modules.

ASK ON THE TASK (user's call, ~15.9k rows): (a) fix the families / (b) accept+register+re-bless / (c) split. RECOMMENDED (c), starting with Text::Balanced (one gap, one module, 766 rows, a whole dist). Plus two durable amendments: add the perl suite as a fourth audited population, and require a COLD cache for any live-v1 audit.

Also surfaced: mro/inconsistent_c3_utf8.t is STALE (blessed expected-divergence row now passes -> remove from docs/perl-suite-expected.tsv); comp/hints.t + mro/inconsistent_c3.t XDIFF -> DIFF (blessed row sets grew unregistered rows). Gains: op/push.t, op/splice.t, op/unshift.t DIFF -> OK; board Role-Tiny subclass.t FAIL -> PARTIAL (#251/M7 landing).
